parameters.query: SELECT client FROM reportes.client_tokens WHERE active = true ORDER BY client

INSERT INTO reportes.snapshots (client, week, r2_key, content_hash)
SELECT j->>'client', j->>'week', j->>'r2_key', encode(digest(j->>'html', 'sha256'), 'hex')
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j) p
WHERE (p.j->>'mock') IS DISTINCT FROM 'yes'
ON CONFLICT (client, week) DO UPDATE SET
    r2_key = EXCLUDED.r2_key,
    content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
    created_at = now()
RETURNING id, client, week, r2_key

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ client: $json.client, week: $json.week, r2_key: $json.r2key, html: $json.html, mock: $json.mock || '' }) }}
